page: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DADSv5 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The configuration features 96 dedicated vCPUs derived from 48 physical cores with 2 threads per core. It includes 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled with a local 3686 GB SSD, and the instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. No GPU accelerators are included.

Benchmark evaluations show top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core tests and PassMark CPU encryption tests ranking in the top 10%. PassMark memory scores also place in the top 10%. Multi-threaded operations, such as bzip3 decompression and Geekbench multi-core tasks, rank in the top 25%. Database operations and Redis SET operations demonstrate strong performance in the top 25%, while large-block memory bandwidth and static web serving throughput register in the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D96ads_v5 offers a high-density resource profile, combining substantial compute power with a large local SSD storage allocation. This makes it highly suitable for workloads that require balanced CPU and memory resources alongside fast local temporary storage. Recommended workloads include relational databases, Redis caching layers, multi-threaded software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure D96ads_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with 96 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, this x86_64 instance features a bundled 3686 GB local SSD, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance and memory scores, alongside strong database and Redis SET operations. While single-core and large-block memory bandwidth benchmarks fall into the average tier, the server excels in multi-threaded tasks, software compilation, and cryptography. The combination of high-density compute resources and substantial local SSD storage makes the D96ads_v5 highly cost-efficient for demanding enterprise workloads, relational databases, caching layers, and multi-threaded data processing.
